blocks.text: San José: traffic around a palm-lined square

After breakfast, take a sightseeing tour of the capital.

You’ll see parks, central streets and several neighbourhoods in San José.

Your guide will explain the capital’s history, local culture and how the city has developed.

It’s an easy-paced introduction to San José before you head to the country’s natural areas.

Breakfast is included.
Costa Rica’s National Theatre and the mosaic-paved square in San José
San José: the theatre façade and pedestrians in a patterned square
San José to Arenal via Poás Volcano and La Paz

After breakfast, you’ll be picked up from your hotel and head towards the Central Mountain Range.

As you climb towards Poás Volcano, the temperature and vegetation change. Along the way, you’ll pass coffee plantations and farms growing ferns, flowers and strawberries.

At Poás, you’ll see the main crater with its hydrogen sulfide fumaroles and learn about the national park’s different ecosystems.

From the volcano, continue to La Paz Waterfall Gardens.

Lunch is scheduled here.

Then follow a trail through the tropical forest to a waterfall.

You can also visit the hummingbird gallery, serpentarium, aviary, butterfly garden and frog exhibit inside the park.

After the tour, drive to the northern lowlands around Arenal Volcano and the town of La Fortuna.

End the day relaxing in the region’s hot springs.

Breakfast and lunch are included.
